newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-S.Barney restates Morris buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-S.Barney restates Morris buy.

text.p: -- Smith Barney restated its buy rating on Philip Morris Cos Inc and analyst Martin Feldman said the company's deal to control Portugal's state-owned Tabaqueira will enhance the tobacco giant's margins and pressure competition.
-- Smith Barney expects 12-month returns in excess of 20 percent for investors purchasing Philip Morris at the current price.
-- Feldman said in a research report investors should "continue to overweight Philip Morris."
-- A Philip Morris consortium on Thursday won control of Tabaqueira for $215 million. An additional $50 million capital investment is expected.

-- Philip Morris now controls 96.3 percent of the Portuguese cigarette market, Smith Barney said. The company has promised to expand cigarette production in Portugal by 50 percent by the year 2001, to 21 billion cigarettes. Production in 1996 is expected to be about 13.9 billion cigarettes, Smith Barney said. -- Philip Morris now owns Portugal's three highest-volume brands. Tabaqueira gives Philip Morris a key, low-cost production base in Europe, Smith Barney said. -- Philip Morris gained 1-3/4 to 115-1/2 in early morning trading.
